subject: Partial-hourly token reassign & evidence request — mid-cycle invoice spike
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@fletcher.co>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Finance AP <ap@fletcher.co>
Date: 2027-05-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected mid-cycle spike on May 24 invoice — details attached

Hi Karthik,

We noticed a ~3.8x jump in token spend for our staging POST requests on 2027-05-24 between 14:00–15:00 UTC on invoice May2027 (attached). Can you help explain what triggered the jump? Our team hasn't pushed any heavy retrains or new batch jobs.

What we need:
- Token-level samples (1-minute granularity) for the window 14:00–15:00 UTC on 5/24.
- Any routing/aux model changes or rollouts that could have shifted to a higher-cost model.
- Confirmation if EU VAT was applied inconsistently for part of the window (we saw VAT variances line-itemed).

We've attached the May invoice excerpt (invoice_May2027.pdf). Happy to pull additional logs if you tell us the identifiers we should share. We are placing a temporary payment hold pending clarification — our AP team is copied.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of AI Ops
Fletcher Technologies
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@fletcher.co>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, Finance AP <ap@fletcher.co>
Date: 2027-05-25T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle spike on May 24 invoice — details attached

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice. We're going to treat this as a priority.

Short answers up front:
- We'll pull minute-level token samples for the 14:00–15:00 UTC window and include model variant, route, and request_id.
- I'll check the rollout logs to see if a canary or quantization profile changed routing during that hour.
- We'll confirm VAT treatment for the line items and whether a reverse-charge or EU entity mismatch caused the variance.

Can you confirm two things so we can pull the minimal set of logs:
1) Which API key(s) were used for the requests in that window (a short list is fine).
2) Do you want us to redact prompt contents for privacy when we export samples? (we can provide token counts + prompt hashes instead).

I'll loop in Ben (billing investigations) and Monica (customer success) to coordinate a provisional credit and timeline. Expect an initial update within 4 business hours.

— Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Reliability & Billing
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-25T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle spike on May 24 invoice — internal next steps

Karthik / Monica — quick plan:
1) Engineering: pull token-level samples for 2027-05-24 14:00–15:00 UTC with these columns: timestamp, request_id, api_key_id, model_variant, token_in, token_out, route. If prompts are sensitive, include prompt_hash and token counts.
2) Billing: prepare a provisional credit for the anomalous window (suggest 50% of the spike delta) to remove pressure on collection while we investigate.
3) Tax: verify VAT tags for those call stacks — if any calls were routed through a non-EU entity and mis-tagged, coordinate a VAT reclass and update invoice line items.

I've attached a small CSV template (usage-sample-20270524.csv) that we can use to present evidence to the customer. If engineering can drop a sample by EOD we'll send an interim note to Liam and AP confirming the provisional credit and ETA.

Ben Carter
Senior Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Finance AP <ap@fletcher.co>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@fletcher.co>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-26T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle spike on May 24 invoice — payment hold acknowledged

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 10:04 AM karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Liam — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the invoice. We're going to treat this as a priority.
> 
> Short answers up front:
> - We'll pull minute-level token samples for the 14:00–15:00 UTC window and include model variant, route, and request_id.
> - I'll check the rollout logs to see if a canary or quantization profile changed routing during that hour.
> - We'll confirm VAT treatment for the line items and whether a reverse-charge or EU entity mismatch caused the variance.

Thanks for the quick acknowledgement. We accept a provisional credit (to be agreed by both sides) while you produce the token-level evidence. Please provide the sample CSV and routing log excerpt no later than 2027-05-27 18:00 UTC.

For privacy reasons we prefer redacted prompt text; prompt_hash and token counts are fine. Also confirm whether Redwood will be issuing a corrected invoice (credit memo) or an internal adjustment that we apply when reconciling.

Regards,
Finance AP
Fletcher Technologies
